access_rule: Every request: valid token, active user, identity taken only from the token; an unknown claim gets the same 403 as a forbidden one; every request is audited.
adjuster: read and assess only claims assigned to them; confirm own claims with net payable up to $25,000.
senior-adjuster: read and assess every claim; confirm any claim, and is the only role that may confirm net payable above $25,000 (CLS-PAY-012).
fraud-investigator: claims assigned to them plus claims with vendor fraud score >= 0.70 (provisional threshold); review only, never confirms.
total-loss-appraiser: claims assigned to them plus total-loss candidates (repair >= 75% of ACV, CLS-TL-005); review only, never confirms.
Test-only identities never own course claims and exist only for negative tests.

users.name: Frank Test (suspended)
users.purpose: A suspended adjuster must be refused even with a valid token

users.name: Pipeline service account
users.purpose: A service account may never read claims for adjudication or confirm a decision
